Flow.description:
Products in this calculation: Cross Border Payments - FWXB1000
Migrated PB [Opp Product] Edu XB Revenue Calculator. 1/5/24 SAL-3427 ARR $ updates 2/14 SAL-3707 Corrected Calc for AUS Lang&Other 2/15 SAL-3707 Correct Formula Names, Copy Product Family only when null SAL-3698. Added ByPass to skip validation rules on Opportunity 05/14/2024. Update ARR instead of UnitPrice 07/09/2024. Update to make currency conversion and filter by product code; renewals should not generate ARR; use Ship_To_Account__r 07/24/2024. Use Quote_Line_Type__c instead of Opportunity.Type 07/26/2024. Update 08/29/2024 Remove Adjusted_Total_Text__c update, the field is deprecated. BOPI-511 Updated to calculate ARR when Quote Line Type not 'Cancellation' or 'Renewal'. BOPI-518 Updated to get baseline ARR from original opportunity product and set Net ARR. BOPI-518 removing Opp criteria filters to let the flow run when renewals are created and the quote line fields are empty. BOPI-603 updated to set ARR to 0 for cancelled lines. BOPI-620 updated to set the ARR for cancelled lines to the original amount as a negative value. SALDEV-1186 updated ARR calculation formulas and revenue text formulas for each region
